name: ja_cn_revenue_today_20260821
sql:
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#varchar_id" AS "#account_id"
    FROM user_result_cluster_4
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users')
),
RawPayEvents AS (
    SELECT
        v."#account_id",
        CAST(v.payload.curamt AS DOUBLE) AS pay_amount_rmb,
        v."$part_date" AS pay_date,
        HOUR(CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP)) AS event_hour
    FROM ta.v_event_4 v
    WHERE v."$part_date" = '2026-08-21'
      AND v."$part_event" = 'PURCHASE'
      AND (v.payload.validationtype IS NULL OR v.payload.validationtype <> 'SANDBOX_RECEIPT')
),
ValidPayEvents AS (
    SELECT e.*
    FROM RawPayEvents e
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist ub ON e."#account_id" = ub."#account_id"
    WHERE ub."#account_id" IS NULL
)
SELECT
    pay_date AS "date",
    ROUND(SUM(pay_amount_rmb), 2) AS "revenue_rmb",
    COUNT(*) AS "valid_orders",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "#account_id") AS "payers",
    MAX(event_hour) AS "latest_order_hour"
FROM ValidPayEvents
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
